Scenarios.SCN-001: a legacy `children:` declaration produces a syntax diagnostic and no edge.
Scenarios.SCN-002: each supported extension maps to its comment syntax; unknown extensions fall back to the actual leading marker.
Scenarios.SCN-003: recognized preludes (BOM, shebang, XML prolog, frontmatter, DOCTYPE) are skipped before the leading comment area; later declaration-like text is ignored.
Scenarios.SCN-004: a NUL byte in the leading area prevents participation.
